newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 5.

text.p: Taiwan has agreed to import 7,700 cars from Japan in 1997 at a 30 percent tariff and to increase imports by 10 percent a year from next year as part of a bilateral trade deal.

Marubeni Corp, two Norwegian telecommunications companies and a U.S. investment firm plan to invest 18 billion yen to establish a cellular phone service in Bangladish. The venture aims to gain 250,000 subscribers.
Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) plans to buy into Cable Television Tokyo, a Tokyo-based cable television company.

Fujitsu Ltd is expecting to post a record group net profit of around 90 billion yen and a parent current profit of about 130 billion yen in the 1997/98 business year, helped by strong domestic sales of computer systems and improvements in earnings of its overseas units.

Matsushita-Kotobuki Electronics Industries Ltd will increase its pre-tax profit in the year to the end of March 3.6 times against last year to around 29 billion yen if the dollar stays around the 120 yen level.

Calsonic Corp is expected to see an 11 percent drop in its pre-tax profit to 6.1 billion yen in the year to March, helped by smaller-than-expected fall in domestic vehicle production by Nissan Motor Co Ltd.
